verdict.rationale: LangGraph documents durable, long-running stateful agents that persist through failures and resume automatically. It also documents an Agent Server exposing run and thread endpoints, so autonomous, extended execution is the product's own capability. However, nothing in the evidence shows background or scheduled triggers: no cron, recurring schedules, event triggers or fire-and-forget background runs. Long-running execution is not the same as a set-up automation. Missing for 10: documented scheduled/cron or recurring runs, background-run or trigger configuration, independent hands-on corroboration of unattended automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Build agents that persist through failures and can run for extended periods, automatically resuming from exactly where they left off.
LangGraph is a low-level orchestration framework for building, managing, and deploying long-running, stateful agents.
The resulting server exposes all API endpoints for runs, threads, assistants, etc., and includes supporting services such as a managed database for checkpointing and storage.
